Ticket:
URGENT: Posting payments and ERAs crashing

Hello, I am so sorry to reach out while everything is falling apart, but our billing department is completely blocked right now. Whenever we try to post electronic remittances or apply check payments across multiple invoice lines, the entire ledger module freezes up and throws a server error code. We tried logging out and clearing our browser caches, but nothing is working, and we cannot process any deposits today. Please look into this immediately as our day is completely stalled.
